summary: OEM captures from CHIRP #11669 (v1.14 CPS on first-gen 5RH Pro GPS): same seeded PROGRAM/INFORMATION/52 protocol as V1.17, random seeds accepted (0x20, 0x52, 0x3B, 0x35). UV-5RM Pro answers the announce but sends 4e ('N') to the seeded PROGRAM on two seeds, so it refuses the sync word, not the seed. No official UV-5RM Pro CPS (baofengradio.com 404; BF Series 1.5.1 doesn't cover it). Needs the owner's bundled CPS or a capture
